selectionContract.sampling: Adaptive selection among unseen question IDs; dedicated persisted question RNG breaks equal-priority ties.
selectionContract.whenUsed: Reserve the question ID atomically when it is first shown, not only after a correct answer.
selectionContract.resume: Persist used IDs, pending question ID, choices and answer/hint status. Reload resumes the pending item; it never draws another.
selectionContract.newRun: Keep exposure history across new runs until an explicit reset policy is agreed and implemented.
selectionContract.exhaustion: Do not silently recycle items. Report no unused items in the selected pool; any bank reset must be explicit.
selectionContract.balance: Use a requested topic when supplied; choose the closest available target difficulty, then a less-successful skill. Exhausted pools do not recycle.
selectionContract.rewardGate: Future Claim Artifact education gate requires a separate implementation; this review bank grants no artifacts, HP, Focus or other effects.

questions.hint: At least two means exactly two or all three. The stated disjoint regions do not share any people. Include the three exactly-two regions and the all-three region. Add their counts, including each region once.
questions.explanation: At least two includes the three exactly-two regions and the all-three region: 4+3+5+2=14.

questions.prompt: A guild has 50 members. 28 own a map, 25 own a lantern and 12 own both. How many own exactly one of these two items?
questions.hint: Exactly one means map only or lantern only. People who own both must not be included. Subtract the both count from each ownership count. Add the two resulting only-group counts.
questions.explanation: Map-only=28−12=16; lantern-only=25−12=13. Exactly one=16+13=29.
